sources.note: The final government VFM verifies one June 14, 2019 Project Agreement and one ProjectCo, Fengate Central Health, LP, for both 60-bed homes. It identifies funds managed by Fengate as the risk-capital provider, Pomerleau Inc. as design-builder and the planned April 2051 handback. It does not disclose the ProjectCo limited partners or percentages.
Fengate's direct financial-close page describes one Gander and Grand Falls-Windsor Care Homes project and confirms the manager-led consortium scope.

The current provincial project page describes the two 60-bed facilities under one DBFM procurement, records opening in May 2022 and lists Fengate and SEC Pomerleau as equity providers. The SEC Pomerleau reference conflicts with the post-close VFM treatment.

The provincial RFP release returned HTTP 503 after retries during independent verification. Its single-contract premise is independently established by the accessible final VFM, current project page and manager close release.
The March 28, 2022 government release verifies completion of both new 60-bed homes and states they would soon open.

The Canadian Council for Public-Private Partnerships lists the Grand Falls-Windsor facility as in operation, gives June 14, 2019 financial close and March 2022 substantial completion, and reports a 2052 handback; this creates a noncritical one-year conflict with the final VFM.
Newfoundland and Labrador Health Services lists the Grand Falls-Windsor facility at 9 Scott Avenue and open 24 hours, supporting current operation while not establishing private equity.

The shortlist/team-composition PDF labels Fengate Capital Management and SEC Pomerleau as respondent team leads/equity providers. Because the final VFM identifies only Fengate-managed risk capital and Pomerleau Inc. as design-builder, SEC Pomerleau's post-close equity status remains unresolved.

modelEvidenceCorrections: Treat Grand Falls-Windsor as an underlying facility of the single Gander and Grand Falls-Windsor Care Homes Project, not as a second manager-level PortCo.
Do not add SEC Pomerleau as a current owner without post-close cap-table evidence; the official sources conflict about its equity role.
Do not infer ProjectCo percentages or name a Fengate fund that is not publicly disclosed.
Use April 2051 as the executed/post-close VFM handback date unless a formal amendment proves the 2052 industry-profile date.
releaseRequirement: Merge the standalone Grand Falls-Windsor row into the existing Gander and Grand Falls-Windsor Care Homes Project and retain it as an underlying facility. Preserve Fengate-managed active ownership with undisclosed stake, but resolve SEC Pomerleau's post-close equity status before asserting a complete current cap table.
